lang-store.ja: ついに試験が始まるね。私、気合で駆け抜けるから、一緒に頑張ろうね！
lang-store.en: The trial is finally starting. I'll charge through on spirit, so let's do our best together!

lang-store.ja: 今日から、試験だね。この試験で、僕たちの力を試そう。
lang-store.en: The trial starts today. Let's test our strength in this trial.

lang-store.ja: ついに試験だね。ここで、あたしの魔法の実力を確かめてみるよ。一緒に進もう！
lang-store.en: The trial is finally here. I'll test the strength of my magic here. Let's go on together!

lang-store.ja: 試験の日を迎えましたね。人の助けになれるよう、進みましょう。
lang-store.en: The day of the trial has come. Let's go on, and become able to help people.

lang-store.ja: いよいよ本番だな。胸を張れる仕事を、目指して頑張ろう。
lang-store.en: This is the real thing. Let's work toward a job we can be proud of.

lang-store.ja: ここが試験場につながる入り口ですね。この先の未来を、一緒に見に行きましょう。
lang-store.en: This is the entrance that leads to the trial grounds. Let's go see the future ahead together.

lang-store.ja: いよいよ試験が始まりますね。品物が安全に流通する世の中を、目指して頑張りましょう。
lang-store.en: The trial is finally beginning. Let's work toward a world where goods circulate safely.

lang-store.ja: ふぅ、試験場まで参りました。争いのない世の中を目指して、どんどん進みましょう。
lang-store.en: Phew, we've made it to the trial grounds. Let's press on toward a world without conflict.

lang-store.ja: そうだね！一緒に、最後まで駆けよう！
lang-store.en: Right! Let's run all the way to the end together!

lang-store.ja: そうだね。僕たちで、確実に進もう。
lang-store.en: Right. Let's advance steadily, together.

lang-store.ja: うん！危なくなったら、あたしが魔法で助けるよ！
lang-store.en: Yeah! If it gets dangerous, I'll help with magic!

lang-store.ja: ええ。困っている受験者がいたら、声をかけ合って一緒に進みましょう。
lang-store.en: Yes. If an examinee is in trouble, let's call out to each other and go on together.

lang-store.ja: そうだな。この試験で、お互いさらに腕を磨こう。
lang-store.en: Yeah. Let's hone our skills even further in this trial.

lang-store.ja: 試験中は私が周囲に目を光らせておくので、突き進んでいいですよ。
lang-store.en: I'll keep watch around us during the trial, so go ahead and push forward.

lang-store.ja: そうですね。足りないものがあれば、試験中に私が調達しましょう。
lang-store.en: Yes. If anything is lacking, I'll procure it during the trial.

lang-store.ja: そうですね。交渉ごとがあれば、わたくしにお任せください。
lang-store.en: Yes. If any negotiation arises, please leave it to me.

lang-store.ja: ブライアー！小さい頃の勝負、先に勇者になるのは私になりそうね！
lang-store.en: Briar! Our childhood contest still stands. It looks like I'll be the one to become a hero first!

lang-store.ja: 仲間と協力して戦っていいんだから、一緒に勇者になろうよ。
lang-store.en: We can fight alongside companions, so let's become heroes together.

lang-store.ja: 案内によると……
lang-store.en: The notice says...

lang-store.ja: 7日間で7回も戦わないといけないの！？
lang-store.en: I have to fight seven times in seven days!?

lang-store.ja: 時間がない、急がないと！！
lang-store.en: There's no time. We have to hurry!!

lang-store.ja: 申請すれば期間は延長できるみたいだよ。残り日数に気を付けながら一緒に頑張ろう。
lang-store.en: If we apply, the period can be extended. Let's watch the days we have left and do our best together.

lang-store.ja: ちょっと待って、人の話聞いてる？
lang-store.en: Wait a second. Are you even listening?

lang-store.ja: こんにちは、ダーシー。あなたも試験を受けに来たの？
lang-store.en: Hello, Darcy. Did you come to take the trial too?

lang-store.ja: あら、診療所で一緒に回復の研究をしたとき以来ね。私も試験を受けに来たのよ。
lang-store.en: Oh, it's been since we studied recovery together at the clinic. I came to take the trial too.

lang-store.ja: せっかくなので、一緒に試験を受けませんか？
lang-store.en: Since the chance is here, shall we take the trial together?

lang-store.ja: もちろん！属性軽減が得意なダーシーには、サポート役はお願いするね！
lang-store.en: Of course! You're good at easing attributes, Darcy, so I'll ask you to handle support!

lang-store.ja: あなたは盾を無視する魔法攻撃が得意だから、一緒なら心強いです。
lang-store.en: You're skilled at magic attacks that ignore shields, so I'll feel reassured with you.

lang-store.ja: 力を合わせて、試験を乗り切りましょう。
lang-store.en: Let's join forces and get through the trial.

lang-store.ja: よう、フィンリー。久しぶりだな。
lang-store.en: Hey, Finley. It's been a while.

lang-store.ja: エリスですか。今でも旅団から荷物を盗んでいるのですか？
lang-store.en: Ellis. Are you still stealing luggage from the brigade?

lang-store.ja: 俺は荷物を盗んでいるわけじゃない。敵の装備を剝いで、戦力を落とすのが俺の戦術だ。
lang-store.en: I'm not stealing luggage. Stripping enemy gear to cut their strength is my tactic.

lang-store.ja: 確かに。あの盗賊団を追っていたときも、そんな戦い方でしたね。
lang-store.en: True. You fought that way when we were chasing that bandit group, too.

lang-store.ja: この技術を世の中に活かすため、勇者認定試験を受けに行くところだ。
lang-store.en: I'm on my way to take the hero trial, so I can put this skill to use in the world.

lang-store.ja: 私も試験を受けに行くところです。これも何かの縁ですね。一緒に行きましょうか。
lang-store.en: I'm on my way to take the trial too. This must be some kind of connection. Shall we go together?

lang-store.ja: ハーパー、私はこの試験、戦いに勝つには仕入れが重要だと踏んでいます。
lang-store.en: Harper, for this trial, I figure stocking is what it takes to win fights.

lang-store.ja: 仕入れは私に任せてください。
lang-store.en: Leave the stocking to me.

lang-store.ja: ギルドに行けば試験期間の延長の交渉ができるそうです。そちらは、わたくしが引き受けます。
lang-store.en: I hear that going to the guild lets you negotiate an extension of the trial period. I'll take that.

lang-store.ja: 私は戦闘が得意ではないので、戦闘は任せます。
lang-store.en: I'm not good at combat, so I'll leave the fighting to you.

lang-store.ja: 交渉ができる相手ではなさそうなので、わたくしは遠慮しておきます。
lang-store.en: They don't seem like someone I can negotiate with, so I'll hold back.

lang-store.ja: ………。やはり私たちだとそうなりますね。
lang-store.en: ...... So that's how it turns out for the two of us.

lang-store.ja: まずは一緒に戦う仲間を探しましょうか。
lang-store.en: First, shall we look for companions to fight with?

lang-store.ja: ええ、そうですね。仲間に引き入れる交渉はわたくしにお任せください。
lang-store.en: Yes. Please leave the negotiation to bring companions in to me.

lang-store.ja: よし、倒した！私たち、なかなかやるね！
lang-store.en: Yes, we beat them! We're pretty good together!

lang-store.ja: やっと倒せた。一人だったら、危なかったかもしれないね。
lang-store.en: We finally did it. Alone, I might have been in trouble.

lang-store.ja: 頑張った甲斐があった！やってみると、いろいろ分かって面白いね！
lang-store.en: Our hard work paid off! It's fun finding things out by trying them!

lang-store.ja: 緊張しましたね。でも、こうして乗り切れてよかったです。
lang-store.en: That was tense. But I'm glad we made it through together.

lang-store.ja: やれやれ、ずいぶん手こずらせてくれたな。
lang-store.en: Whew, they sure gave us a hard time.

lang-store.ja: 倒せましたね。これで少し安心できます。
lang-store.en: We defeated them. That's a little weight off our shoulders.

lang-store.ja: 勝てましたね。これだけ頑張ったんですから、試験官にも見ていてほしいです。
lang-store.en: We won! After all that effort, I do hope the examiner was watching.

lang-store.ja: ようやく一息つけますね。少し腰を下ろしたいところです。
lang-store.en: We can finally catch our breath. I'd quite like to sit down for a moment.

lang-store.ja: うん！よく頑張ったよね！
lang-store.en: Yeah! We really gave it our all!

lang-store.ja: そうだね。ひとまず、お疲れさま。
lang-store.en: Yes. Good work, everyone. Let's take a moment.

lang-store.ja: うん、あたしたち、頑張ったよね！
lang-store.en: Yeah, we worked hard for that!

lang-store.ja: ええ、お疲れさまでした。少し息を整えましょう。
lang-store.en: Yes, well done. Let's catch our breath.

lang-store.ja: ああ、ひとまず片付いたな。お疲れさん。
lang-store.en: Yeah, that's taken care of. Good work.

lang-store.ja: はい。少し休んでもよさそうですね。
lang-store.en: Yes. It looks like we can rest a little.

lang-store.ja: ええ、頑張った甲斐がありましたね。
lang-store.en: Indeed, our efforts were worthwhile.

lang-store.ja: ええ。まずは一息つきましょう。
lang-store.en: Yes. Let's take a breather first.

lang-store.ja: 今の戦い、見てたよ！私はアヴェリー。私も受験中なんだ。あなたたち、いいチームだね！
lang-store.en: I saw that fight! I'm Avery. I'm taking the trial too. You make a great team!

lang-store.ja: 見事な戦いだったね。息が合っていて、感心したよ。僕はブライアー。僕も受験者なんだ。
lang-store.en: That was an impressive fight. I'm amazed at how well you work together. I'm Briar, another candidate.

lang-store.ja: へえ、今の戦い、面白かった！……あ、あたしはケイシー。受験中なんだけど、つい見入っちゃった！
lang-store.en: Wow, that fight was fascinating! ...Oh, I'm Casey. I'm taking the trial, but I couldn't help watching!

lang-store.ja: 素晴らしい戦いぶりでしたね。私はダーシー。私も試験を受けています。お怪我があれば、手当てしますよ。
lang-store.en: That was wonderful fighting. I'm Darcy, and I'm taking the trial too. If you're hurt, I can tend to you.

lang-store.ja: いい腕してるな。俺はエリス。俺も受験中だけど、うかうかしてられないぜ。
lang-store.en: You've got some skill. I'm Ellis. I'm taking the trial too, and I'd better stay on my toes.

lang-store.ja: 戦いの音がしたので来てみたんです。私はフィンリー。受験者です。
lang-store.en: I heard fighting and came to see. I'm Finley, a candidate.

lang-store.ja: お見事です！私はガーネット。私にもこんな頼もしい仲間がいれば、試験も心強いのですが。
lang-store.en: Well fought! I'm Garnet. With companions that dependable, I'd feel much more confident about the trial.

lang-store.ja: 鮮やかな戦いぶりでしたね。わたくしはハーパー。わたくしも受験中ですが、皆さまの連携には感心いたしました。
lang-store.en: What splendid fighting. I am Harper. I'm taking the trial too, and your teamwork was most impressive.

lang-store.ja: あなたも受験中なんだね！ねえ、ここから一緒に戦わない？
lang-store.en: You're taking the trial too! Hey, want to fight alongside us from here on?

lang-store.ja: よかったら、一緒に進まない？協力できる相手が増えると心強いよ。
lang-store.en: Would you like to come with us? It's reassuring to have more people we can count on.

lang-store.ja: ねえ、あたしたちと組んでみない？力を合わせたら、もっと面白い戦い方ができそう！
lang-store.en: Hey, want to team up with us? Together, we could try even more interesting ways to fight!

lang-store.ja: よろしければ、私たちと一緒に進みませんか？支え合っていけたらと思います。
lang-store.en: Would you care to join us? I hope we can support one another along the way.

lang-store.ja: せっかく会ったんだ。一緒にやらないか？手が増えるのは歓迎だぜ。
lang-store.en: Since we've met, why not join us? We could always use another pair of hands.

lang-store.ja: よかったら、一緒に行きませんか？一人で進むより、お互いに助け合える方が安心ですから。
lang-store.en: Would you like to come with us? It's more reassuring when we can help each other than going alone.

lang-store.ja: 私たちと組みませんか？得意なことを持ち寄れば、試験も進めやすくなるでしょう。
lang-store.en: Why not team up with us? Combining our strengths should make the trial easier to tackle.

lang-store.ja: よろしければ、ご一緒しませんか？共に試験に挑む仲間を探しているんです。
lang-store.en: Would you care to join us? We're looking for companions to take on the trial together.

lang-store.ja: うん、一緒に行こう！私も力になるから、頼りにしてよね！
lang-store.en: Yeah, let's go together! I'll do my part, so count on me!

lang-store.ja: ありがとう。一緒に行こう。僕も力を尽くすよ。
lang-store.en: Thank you. Let's go together. I'll give it my best too.

lang-store.ja: もちろん！あたしも一緒に戦うよ。いろいろ試せそうで、楽しみ！
lang-store.en: Of course! I'll fight alongside you. I can't wait to try all sorts of things!

lang-store.ja: ありがとうございます。ぜひ、ご一緒させてください。私も支えになれたら嬉しいです。
lang-store.en: Thank you. I'd be delighted to join you. I'll be happy if I can be of help.

lang-store.ja: いいぜ、一緒にやろう。俺の腕も、頼りにしてくれよ。
lang-store.en: Sure, let's do it. You can count on my skills too.

lang-store.ja: はい、一緒に行きます。私にできることがあれば、何でも言ってください。
lang-store.en: Yes, I'll come along. If there's anything I can do, just ask.

lang-store.ja: ありがたいお話です！ぜひ、ご一緒させてください。私もお役に立ってみせますよ。
lang-store.en: What a welcome offer! I'd be delighted to join you. I'll make myself useful, you'll see.

lang-store.ja: 喜んでご一緒します。わたくしも一員として、力を尽くしましょう。
lang-store.en: I'd be happy to join you. I'll do my utmost as part of the team.

lang-store.ja: よし、仲間も増えたし、次も勝つよ！この調子で突っ走ろう！
lang-store.en: All right, our team's grown, and we're winning the next one too! Let's keep charging ahead!

lang-store.ja: 心強くなったね。この仲間で、一つずつ課題を越えていこう。
lang-store.en: That's reassuring. Together, let's tackle the tasks one at a time.

lang-store.ja: さて、どんな戦い方ができるかな！次の課題が楽しみになってきた！
lang-store.en: Now, what kinds of tactics can we try? I'm getting excited for the next task!

lang-store.ja: 頼もしい仲間が増えましたね。支え合って、最後まで乗り切りましょう。
lang-store.en: We've gained a dependable companion. Let's support each other and see this through.

lang-store.ja: よし、いい顔ぶれになったな。次の相手にも、一泡吹かせてやろうぜ。
lang-store.en: All right, we've got a good crew now. Let's give the next enemy a nasty surprise.

lang-store.ja: 一緒に進む人が増えると、足取りも軽くなりますね。次も頑張りましょう。
lang-store.en: Having more people along puts a spring in our step. Let's do our best on the next task too.

lang-store.ja: 頼もしい戦力が加わりましたね！これなら、次の課題も期待できそうです！
lang-store.en: A valuable addition to our strength! Things are looking promising for the next task!

lang-store.ja: では、この仲間で先へ進みましょう。力を合わせれば、道も開けるはずです。
lang-store.en: Then let us press on together. By combining our strengths, we'll find a way forward.

lang-store.ja: あっ、ブライアー！あなたも試験を受けてたんだ！今の戦い、なかなかだったね。でも、私だって負けてないからね！
lang-store.en: Oh, Briar! You're taking the trial too! That was a pretty good fight. But I'm doing just as well, you know!

lang-store.ja: アヴェリー！会えてうれしいよ。ここまで一人で戦ってきたから、知っている顔を見るとほっとするね。
lang-store.en: Avery! I'm glad to see you. I've been fighting alone so far, so it's a relief to see a familiar face.

lang-store.ja: あれ、ダーシー？あなたも試験を受けてたの？診療所じゃなくて、こんなところで会うなんてね！
lang-store.en: Huh, Darcy? You're taking the trial too? Fancy meeting you here instead of at the clinic!

lang-store.ja: あら、ケイシー。あなたも試験に来ていたのね。さっきの魔法、見事でしたよ。
lang-store.en: Oh, Casey. You've come for the trial too. That was some wonderful magic just now.

lang-store.ja: おっ、フィンリーじゃないか。あんたも受験中だったのか。相変わらずいい腕してるな。
lang-store.en: Oh, Finley! You're taking the trial too? You're as good as ever.

lang-store.ja: おや、エリス。まじめに試験を受けに来るとは思いませんでした。
lang-store.en: Well, Ellis. I didn't expect you to come and take the trial seriously.

lang-store.ja: おや、ハーパー！あなたも受験していたんですね。もう頼もしい仲間まで見つけるとは、さすがです。
lang-store.en: Oh, Harper! You're taking the trial too. You've already found dependable companions. Just as I'd expect of you.

lang-store.ja: まあ、ガーネット。試験場でお会いするとは。よい仲間に恵まれましたね。あなたも戦っていらしたのですね。
lang-store.en: Well, Garnet. Fancy meeting you at the trial grounds. You've found good company. So you've been fighting too.

lang-store.ja: うん、君も頑張ってるんだね。よかったら、僕たちと一緒に行こう。君がいてくれたら心強いよ。
lang-store.en: Yes, you've been working hard too. Why not come along with us? I'd feel better with you here.

lang-store.ja: ブライアー！あなたも一緒に来ない？私の活躍、近くで見せてあげる！
lang-store.en: Briar! Why don't you come along too? I'll give you a front-row seat to my victories!

lang-store.ja: ケイシー、久しぶり。よかったら、私たちと一緒に進みませんか？あなたの魔法があれば心強いです。
lang-store.en: Casey, it's been a while. Would you like to come with us? Your magic would be a great help.

lang-store.ja: ダーシー！ねえ、あたしたちと一緒に行こうよ。あなたが属性を軽減してくれたら、すごく助かる！
lang-store.en: Darcy! Hey, come with us! If you can reduce elemental damage for us, that'd be a huge help!

lang-store.ja: エリス。あなたも一緒に行きませんか？装備を奪う相手は、敵だけにしてくださいね。
lang-store.en: Ellis. Would you like to join us? Please keep your equipment stealing to the enemy.

lang-store.ja: 俺だって、やるときはやるさ。あんたも一緒に来ないか？あの盗賊団を追ってたときみたいに、頼りにしてるぜ。
lang-store.en: I can get serious when it counts. Want to join us? I'm counting on you, just like when we were tracking that bandit gang.

lang-store.ja: ええ、皆さまに助けていただいています。あなたもご一緒しませんか？仕入れを任せられる方がいると心強いです。
lang-store.en: Yes, everyone has been most helpful. Would you care to join us? It would be reassuring to have someone I can trust with supplies.

lang-store.ja: 私だって、仕入れだけではありませんよ。あなたも加わりませんか？ギルドとの交渉を任せられると助かります。
lang-store.en: There's more to me than procuring supplies, you know. Why not join us? It would help to leave guild negotiations to you.

lang-store.ja: うん、一緒に行こう！力になるから、頼りにしてよね！
lang-store.en: Yeah, let's go together! I'll do my part, so count on me!

lang-store.ja: うん、一緒に行こう。僕にも手伝わせてね。
lang-store.en: Yes, let's go together. Let me help too.

lang-store.ja: もちろん！ダーシーが支えてくれるなら、あたしも安心して戦えるよ。
lang-store.en: Of course! With you supporting me, Darcy, I can fight without worrying.

lang-store.ja: ええ、ご一緒します。私にできることは任せてください。でも、無理はしないでくださいね。
lang-store.en: Yes, I'll join you. Leave what I can do to me. But please don't push yourself too hard.

lang-store.ja: 敵だけ、ね。分かってるって。仲間の荷物には手を出さないさ。
lang-store.en: Just the enemy, huh? I know, I know. I'll keep my hands off our companions' bags.

lang-store.ja: はい、一緒に行きます。敵だけでなく、あなたにも目を光らせておきますね。
lang-store.en: Yes, I'll come along. I'll keep an eye on you as well as the enemy.

lang-store.ja: もちろんです！必要な品は私が揃えましょう。戦う方も、できる限りはお手伝いしますよ。
lang-store.en: Of course! I'll get us whatever we need. I'll help with the fighting as much as I can too.

lang-store.ja: ええ、喜んで。交渉はわたくしにお任せください。戦いでは、皆さまのお力をお借りしますね。
lang-store.en: Yes, gladly. Leave the negotiations to me. In battle, I'll be relying on everyone's strength.
